notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.21.0 — Goose, the fourth coding/tool agent. Goose (aaif-goose/goose, Apache-2.0) is integrated through its native Agent Client Protocol (goose acp) subprocess, so responses stream as structured events. Every Goose tool call is gated by the app's unified approval system (fail-closed, GOOSE_MODE=approve — no allow-all), and Goose is registered as a coordinator-capable agent in the multi-agent orchestrator. Goose supports the key-based providers already managed by the app (Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, NVIDIA NIM and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints) with credentials injected from the device-bound vault — never written to a plaintext config file. Installs on demand as the official pinned ARM64 musl binary (SHA-256 verified) with update check and background-mode support. Signed (V2) with the unchanged production certificate.
